# PII overlay (fictitious)

600 ticket-like messages with labelled personal data, and the 120 fictitious people they mention.
Built for three lessons: measuring redaction (span recall and precision), answering a data subject
access or erasure request (DSAR), and routing EU accounts by residency.

**Not training data.** The classifiers, the semantic model and the policy index never read this
folder. Nothing here appears in `tickets.jsonl`, the golden sets or the adversarial set.

**Every value is fictitious by construction.** Generated by `data-gen/generate_pii.py` (seeded, no
model calls) from these sources only:

| Kind | Source of values |
| --- | --- |
| Email | Reserved domains only: `<company>.example`, `example.com`, `example.org`, `example.net` (RFC 2606, RFC 6761) |
| Phone, US | NANP fictitious range 555-0100 to 555-0199 |
| Phone, Germany | Bundesnetzagentur drama numbers: 030 23125, 069 90009, 040 66969, 0221 4710, 089 99998 (000 to 999), 0171 39200 and 0176 040690 blocks |
| IBAN | The SWIFT IBAN registry specimen numbers (DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 and six others) |
| Card | The networks' published test numbers (4111 1111 1111 1111 and similar) |
| IP | Documentation ranges 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24, 2001:db8::/32 |
| Name | Common first names with invented surnames built from syllables |
| Address | Invented streets in invented towns (Musterstadt, Beispielhausen, Exampleville) |
| Account | Ids from `data/accounts.json` (synthetic) |
| Invoice, key | Invented formats; keys use `nw_test_`, `nw_live_`, `key-` prefixes with random bodies (never a real vendor prefix such as Stripe's `sk_test_`, which secret scanners block) |

## messages.jsonl

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | `PII-0001` upwards |
| `split` | `dev` (tune a detector here) or `test` (report on this, never tune on it), alternating |
| `kind` | `ticket` (subject and body), `thread` (one turn of a multi-turn exchange), `clean` (no PII, hard negatives only) |
| `thread_id`, `turn`, `role` | For threads: `TH-0001`, turn from 0, `customer` or `agent`. Agent turns echo customer data, as real replies do |
| `account_id`, `residency` | The account and its region (`us`, `eu`, `apac`) from `accounts.json` |
| `language` | `en` or `de` |
| `subject_keys` | Pseudonymous keys (`ds-` plus 12 hex) of every data subject the message is about. The erasure and DSAR key |
| `subject`, `subject_spans` | The subject line (empty for thread turns) and its ground-truth spans |
| `text`, `spans` | The message and its ground-truth spans: `start`, `end` (character offsets into `text`, end exclusive), `label`, `value`, `field` |

`text` and `spans` are the shape `nw.policy.redact.load_labelled` reads, so the file scores as is.
Labels match the redactor's kinds: `NAME`, `EMAIL`, `PHONE`, `ADDRESS`, `IBAN`, `CARD`, `ACCOUNT`, `INVOICE`, `IP`, `KEY`.
A value repeated in a message has one span per occurrence. Company names are not labelled: they
identify a business customer, not a person. Every text also carries hard negatives that a naive
pattern confuses with PII (ISO and German dates, versions, run ids, amounts, UUIDs, ticket ids).
Some invoice ids are written `NW-12345-R`, which an account pattern also matches: the label is
`INVOICE`.

## subjects.jsonl

One line per fictitious person: `subject_key`, `name`, `email`, `phone`, `address`, `account_id`,
`company`, `region`, `language`, `iban`. A DSAR drill starts from one line here and must find every
message, capture, trace, index entry and memory that holds the person (see
`docs/governance/retention-and-erasure.md`).

## Baseline

Score any redactor with `uv run python -m nw.policy.redact --eval data/pii/messages.jsonl
--detector none|heuristic|presidio` (report on `split: test` rows when you tune on `dev`). Measured
on 2026-09-30 over all 600 messages (`text` spans only; a gold span counts as found when any
predicted span overlaps it):

| Label | Patterns only (`none`) | `heuristic` |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| ACCOUNT, CARD, EMAIL, IBAN | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| PHONE | 0.80 | 0.80 |
| IP | 0.75 (misses IPv6) | 0.75 |
| INVOICE | 0.74 | 0.74 |
| KEY | 0.48 | 0.48 |
| ADDRESS | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| NAME | 0.00 | 0.13 |
| All spans, recall | 0.59 | 0.72 |
| All spans, precision | 1.00 | 1.00 |

The redactor changes over the course; rerun the command rather than trusting this table.

Regenerate with `cd solution && uv run python ../data-gen/generate_pii.py`, then
`uv run python -m nw.data_manifest` so `make check-data` passes.
